rules.text: Universal fixed pedestals: 15"W; 25 1/2"H and 27"H; depths 17 1/2", 22 5/8", 28 5/8" (flush steel front) or 18 3/8", 23 1/2", 29 1/2" (proud steel or wood front).
Universal mobile pedestals: 15"W; 21"H (box/file) and 27"H; depths 17 1/2" or 22 5/8" (flush steel) or 18 3/8" or 23 1/2" (proud steel or wood).
Universal sliding door bins for Answer: 15 3/4"D x 16 1/4"H; widths 36, 42, 48, 60, 66, 72".

Universal over the case and in the case bins for Answer: 15 3/4"D x 16 1/4"H; widths 24, 30, 36, 42, 48, 60, 66, 72". 24"W to 48"W have one door; 60"W to 72"W have two doors. Fronts: flat steel, flat wood (in the case), radius steel (over the case).
Universal shelves: 14 3/4"D x 7 1/2"H; widths 24, 30, 36, 42, 48, 60, 72". Universal personal shelves: 13 11/16"D; widths 24, 30, 36, 42, 48".
Universal curved front bins: 16 1/2"D x 15"H; widths 30, 36, 42, 48". Universal L-shelves and stationary shelves: 14"D; widths 30, 36, 42, 48".

Universal one-high (16"H) and 1.5-high (22"H) lateral files: widths 30, 36, 42"; depths 18"/23 1/8" (flush) or 18 7/8"/24" (proud). Fronts: flush steel, proud steel or wood, and flush/proud steel open fronts.
42"W lateral files are available 18"D and 18 7/8"D only.

Universal open side towers and dual door towers: 24"W; 47 1/2", 52", 65 1/2"H. Open side towers: depths 18/23 1/8/29 1/8" (flush) or 18 7/8/24/30" (proud). Dual door towers: 18 or 23 1/8" (flush), 18 7/8 or 24" (proud). Drawings show door hinged left; units also available with door hinged right.
Universal full front towers: 24"W; 52" and 65 1/2"H; 23 1/8"D (flush) / 24"D (proud). Universal vertical drawer towers: 24"W; 52" and 65 1/2"H; 23 1/8 or 29 1/8"D (flush), 24 or 30"D (proud).

Universal workstation verticals: 15"W; 52" and 65 1/2"H; 23 1/8 or 29 1/8"D (flush), 24 or 30"D (proud). Universal lateral files: 30, 36, 42"W; 28, 40, 52, 65 1/2"H; 18 or 23 1/8"D (flush), 18 7/8 or 24"D (proud). 42"W lateral files available 18"D and 18 7/8"D only.

27"H fixed pedestals are floor-standing and support worksurfaces at 28 1/2"H; the 3"H base is integral to the 27"H case and gives base alignment with other Universal Storage components that have a 3"H base.
Fixed pedestal top is open and accommodates attachment to a worksurface; attachment hardware is included.
Lock is standard on pedestals and secures all drawers; lock is located in the top drawer; standard factory-installed, keyed random.
Leveling glides: 25 1/2"H pedestals have a 7/8" adjustable glide range; 27"H pedestals have a 1 7/8" adjustable glide range.

Flush-front pedestal pull is full width and integral, available on steel drawer fronts only. Full-width wood pull is an option; it ships separately and is field installed with double-sided tape to the integral pull.

File drawers accommodate front-to-back filing of hanging letter-size folders; optional rails accommodate side-to-side filing of letter-, A4-, and legal-size folders. Exception: legal-size file folders cannot be filed in 17 1/2"D (printed ambiguously as 17 1/8 or 17 7/8) or 18 3/8"D pedestals; only 22 5/8, 23 1/2, 28 5/8 and 29 1/2"D pedestals accommodate legal-size filing (tip p.609).

Mobile pedestal casters are hard composition, non-locking, full-rotation swivel; casters exposed at base of box/file pedestals and concealed on box/box/file and file/file. Top on mobile pedestal is 1/8"H steel; additional top options available.
Mobile pedestal cushion top provides a temporary seat; optional handle; available factory- or field-installed.

Actual dimensions: fixed depth 17 1/2, 22 5/8, 28 5/8" (flush) / 18 3/8, 23 1/2, 29 1/2" (proud steel or wood), width 15", height 25 1/2" and 27"; mobile box/file and box/box/file & file/file depths 17 1/2 & 22 5/8" (flush) / 18 3/8 & 23 1/2" (proud); overall height with 1/8"H top: box/file 21", box/box/file and file/file 27".
Pencil tray is included with each box/box/file pedestal. Optional basic drawer interior allows box/box/file pedestals to be ordered without rails, box drawer dividers, or pencil trays.
Proud-front pulls: contemporary, handle, jazz, bar (each 128 mm) on steel or wood veneer drawers; c:scape pulls (200 mm) on steel drawers only.
Safety interlock system allows only one drawer to be opened at a time.
Individual drawer locks are available on file/file pedestals only and are only available with field-installed lock cylinders. Non-locking pedestal is an option.
Top options on mobile pedestals in place of standard 1/8"H steel top: 1"H steel, 1 3/16"H laminate square edge, 1 7/16"H laminate with bullnose front edge, 1 3/16"H wood veneer square edge.
Mobile pedestal cushion top for field installation can be used with RPM2421CP, RPM2421CF and RPM2421CW only.

Fixed pedestals are intended to attach under a worksurface; three depths correspond with Universal Worksurface depths; proud-front pedestals exactly match worksurface depth, flush-front pedestals are 7/8" shorter.

Filler conceals gap between panel face and back of a 27"H pedestal and provides stability for pedestal/worksurface configurations that are not panel-wrapped. Fillers for proud front pedestals conceal a 1/2" gap; fillers for flush front pedestals conceal a 1 3/8" gap.
Pedestals may require counterweights when used in stand-alone desks (see Desk Stability Guidelines, page 124).
Freestanding applications that don't require attachment to a worksurface should use a conversion kit (steel top, counterweight package, components to convert locking system to safety interlock).
Fixed pedestals do not accommodate cable-routing; plan accordingly under worksurfaces with grommets or other cable-routing accessories.

Pull finishes: contemporary, handle, jazz, bar pulls 0835 Black, 9201 Polished Chrome, 9211 Nickel, 9212 Silver; c:scape pull 4140 Arctic White Gloss, 4144 Black Gloss, 4799 Platinum Metallic. Lock 9201 Polished Chrome or 9250 Ember Chrome (option). Drawer bodies, suspensions, rails, dividers, glides: black.
On-module attachment brackets are independent of the bin and unique to the panel system; they mount bins on panels of the same width as the bin and are included with the bin as standard.

Vertical off-module brackets (optional) mount one or two sides of an overhead bin off-module on Answer, Kick, Series 9000, Avenir and Montage panels with vertical slot patterns. One side off-module: specify one vertical off-module bracket; two sides off-module: specify two. Both attach to the standard on-module bracket.
Vertical off-module brackets are used with bins up to 12" wider than the panel, allowing them to overhang the panel seam.

Sliding door bin lock can lock the door closed on either the right- or left-hand side; lock located underneath the center of the shelf; standard factory-installed keyed random; no-lock option available.

Upmount brackets (optional) for use on Answer, Kick, Series 9000, Avenir and Montage enable overhead storage on lower panel heights. Bins using an upmount bracket must be installed on a panel of the same width. For Montage, upmount brackets attach near the top of a 55"H frame.
Universal sliding door bin may be mounted at 38"H or lower if another panel-mounted component prevents it from being seated upon.

Two upmount bin brackets can be hung side-by-side in an in-line, T-, or X- application. Bin can be upmounted on slatwall skin as long as there is not another bin or another slatwall skin on the adjacent in-line panel.

Omit brackets option must be specified when bin is used in hutch kit or Series 9000 service module application, or when attaching bin to a horizontal wall attachment bracket. Order hutch kit or Series 9000 service module package separately.
When mounting on Answer or Kick panels, top of bin cannot be loaded.
Width of overhead bin must match the width of the panel or panels it is attached to when using an on-module bracket. Bin may span up to two frames.
Additional support for stability may be required when overhead bins are attached to panels; counterbalancing loads on opposite sides of panels increases stability.
Horizontal wall attachment brackets attach storage bins to the wall of a building; specify as a separate style number and select the omit brackets option when ordering the bin.

Wall channels attach bins to concrete or block walls, and to wood, dry wall or plaster walls if the wall is reinforced. Wall channel horizontal brace is required with wall channels to support bins wider than 48".
Hanging components cannot be used next to a double-pane window at a 90 degree corner, and cannot be hung in front of a double-pane window.

Clearance between Universal Systems worksurfaces or Universal tables and bottom of overhead bins is 21 3/8" when storage unit is installed in the highest position on a 66"H panel and glides are adjusted all the way into the panel.
TS Series bins, Universal bins, and shelves can hang from the first stacked tier only.
On-module and vertical off-module attachment brackets: black paint only. Upmount brackets: paint. Dividers: white plastic.

On-module bracket style number suffixes indicate the panels they attach to: TAK = Answer and Kick; S9 = Series 9000; AVR = Avenir; MON = Montage. Additional on-module brackets for a different panel can be purchased through Service Parts.
Over the case / in the case bin locks are standard, located underneath center of shelf, factory-installed keyed random; two-door units are keyed alike; no-lock option available.
Upmount brackets attach the bin near the top of a 54"H panel to enable overhead storage on lower panel heights; bins using an upmount bracket must be installed on a panel of the same width.

Picture frame door (optional) is available on Universal over the case and in the case bins with flat steel fronts only (aluminum door frame with acrylic, markerboard or glass insert; omit insert option allows custom material to be field installed).
A door assist mechanism is not available as an option on a bin with an acrylic door insert.

If a markerboard door insert or glass door insert option is specified and a door assist mechanism is also required, the assist mechanism must be specified as a separate option; assist mechanism recommended with glass insert due to weight.

Omit insert custom material must be ordered from a material vendor; if omit insert is specified and a door assist mechanism is required, assist mechanism must be specified separately. Custom insert weight on an over the case bin door with assist mechanism must be within 7 1/4 to 10 1/2 pounds; weight of a custom insert without assist cannot exceed 10 1/2 pounds. Safety glass required if installing custom glass; cut to the sizes listed on page 283.
Door assist mechanism (gas cylinder and spring): Universal bins ship with two assist mechanisms per door when specified.
Horizontal off-module attachment brackets for Montage: paint to match bin.

A custom picture frame door insert cannot be factory installed; it must be ordered from a material vendor and is not handled like Customer's Own Material. Do not use materials that allow the insert to deviate beyond the tolerances listed.
Universal shelves are supported by Answer, Kick, Series 9000, Avenir and Montage. Universal personal shelves attach to Answer, Kick, Series 9000 and Avenir.
Universal personal shelves do not have a backstop. Dividers cannot attach to Universal personal shelves.
A 1 1/2" gap exists between the personal shelf and the panel to allow for cable routing. Height dimension of the personal shelf bracket (top of shelf to bottom of bracket) is 6 1/2"H.
On-module attachment hooks (shelves) cannot be attached to upmount brackets.
Width of shelf must match the width of the panel or panels that it is attached to with the on-module brackets. Shelves may span up to two frames.

RDIV dividers (carton of four, white plastic) divide space in panel-supported bins and Universal shelves; they will not work in Universal curved front bins or bins and shelves introduced prior to March 2007; can be used on hutch kit or Series 9000 service module package accessory rail.
TS7STDIV dividers (clear textured plastic) are for overhead storage bins and shelves introduced prior to March 2007.

Horizontal wall attachment brackets attach Universal sliding door, Universal over the case and Universal in the case bins to a building wall. They will not accept bins introduced prior to March 2007, TS Series bins or Universal curved front bins. Specify as a separate style number.
Horizontal wall attachment brackets must match the width of the storage bin; select the omit brackets option when ordering the bin. Brackets include a steel back to enclose the bin.

Shelves cannot hang off horizontal wall attachment brackets. Limit of one bin for each horizontal wall attachment bracket. Attaching worksurfaces to horizontal wall attachment brackets is not possible.

Mounting must attach to at least two wall studs (recommended all studs behind the bin). 24"W or 25"W bins can only be mounted with horizontal wall attachment brackets if the wall is constructed with 16" stud centers.

Field install: concrete walls with Hilti type anchors; drywall or plywood with 5/8" thick Toggler R-type 3/16" wall anchors with countersunk flat head screw; wood studs with #10 wood screws; steel studs with #10 sheet metal screws.

Slotted steel wall channel attaches to building wall to accept shelves, overhead storage bins, worksurfaces or tackboards; accepts all Universal bins and shelves, TS Series bins and bins and shelves introduced prior to March 2007. Must specify bin or shelf with Answer, Kick, Avenir or Series 9000 bracket to hang on wall channel.
Component limits for each pair of wall channels: two bins or shelves; or one worksurface and two shelves; or one worksurface and one bin.

Anchors must be used in each screw hole location on the wall channel. Components attach at 1" increments, but screws block some slot locations. Screw hole positions (66"H channel): 10 1/4", then 22 5/8" and 22 5/8" spacing.

Horizontal brace is available to reinforce vertical wall channels supporting storage bins, shelves or worksurfaces attached to walls. Bins and shelves 48"W or less do not require a horizontal brace. All worksurfaces require horizontal braces.

Wall channel horizontal brace is required for EACH storage bin or shelf wider than 48"; brace placed along the vertical wall channel where the top of the bin or shelf will be placed. Width of horizontal brace must match width of shelf or storage bin.
Wall channel horizontal brace also available in 42" and 48" widths for applications where there is concern regarding wall strength; these braces must also be used with wall-mounted worksurfaces.
Wall hang channels for shelves, overhead storage bins or tackboards cannot be used with a wall start junction.

Worksurfaces on wall channels with cantilevers: worksurfaces must be 24"D or less; supported by a cantilever or legs every 42" or 48" (cantilevers can be shared when worksurfaces are adjacent); wall channel horizontal braces must be installed directly behind all wall-mounted worksurfaces and at the top of the wall channels; worksurface-supported pedestals cannot be hung from a wall-mounted worksurface.
Reinforce wall by positioning studs where wall channels attach; distance between center lines of reinforced wall channels matches width of overhead storage unit. Wall channels can be shared.
Wall hang channels and horizontal braces actual dimensions: depth 1 1/8" (28 mm), width 15/16" (24 mm), channel height 66" (1676 mm).

Curved front bins: shelf, top and back steel; side panels plastic; door steel or wood; ship fully assembled. Basic attachment brackets mount bins on panels with vertical slot patterns; bracket allows bin to be flush with the bracket or to extend beyond the bracket up to 12".

Basic and open design upmount brackets (optional) attach bin near the top of a 54"H panel. Exception: open design upmount bracket cannot be used when double-pane window is in top position of panel. When using upmount brackets with overhead storage and daisy chaining lights, use the open design upmount bracket for better cord management.

Curved front bin actual dimensions: depth 16 1/2", inside depth 13 3/4", widths 30/36/42/48" (inside widths 27 1/4, 33 1/4, 39 1/4, 45 1/4"), height 15", height with door open 23", inside height 13 3/4".

Upmounted curved front bins can be attached above or adjacent to a slatwall skin as long as there is not another bin or another slatwall skin on the adjacent in-line panel. When curved front bin is upmounted, slotted channels are visible; a flat steel back is available through Specials.
Ganging bracket is recommended on all panels; it joins adjacent overhead bins and shelves for optimal visual alignment; ordered separately. Stationary shelves can be added to bins on site.

Stationary shelf hangs from the bottom of curved front bins with KBIN_ style numbers; 5 1/2" between bottom of bin and top of stationary shelf; stationary shelf height 6 5/32"; specify same width as corresponding bin. Stationary shelf cannot hang from an upmounted bin or shelf.
Top of curved front bin cannot be loaded. Back of bin is closed. Bin has access holes in bottom for wire management.
For New York City, tool-free clips are required for flush mount Underline task light applications.

Curved front bin surface materials: bins paint or metallic paint (optional); side panel color molded plastic to match bin color if textured paint, or painted plastic to match if metallic paint; fronts paint, metallic paint (optional) or wood (optional); basic attachment brackets black; basic upmount bracket painted to match bin; open design upmount bracket shiny chrome; stationary shelf paint or metallic paint (optional); stationary shelf endcaps 6695 Midnight only; attachment rods shiny chrome.

Open design upmount bin and shelf bracket cannot be used when double-pane window is in top position of panel. Hanging components cannot be hung in front of a double-pane window or next to a double-pane window at a 90 degree corner.

L-shelf and back are steel; L-shelf is partially field-assembled; endcaps molded plastic; 5/16" diameter rods at the sides. Basic attachment brackets mount on panels with vertical slot patterns; bracket allows shelf to be flush with bracket or extend beyond it up to 12".

Basic and open design upmount brackets (optional) attach shelf near the top of 54"H panel. Exception: open design upmount bracket cannot be used when double-pane window is in top position of panel. With upmount brackets and daisy-chained lights use the open design upmount bracket for better cord management.
L-shelf actual dimensions: depth 14 1/4"; widths 29 7/8, 35 7/8, 41 7/8, 47 7/8" (inside widths 25 3/4, 31 3/4, 37 3/4, 43 3/4"); height 15"; shelf thickness 5/8".
Spacers on L-shelf provide 1/4" gap between back and shelf.

Stationary shelf hangs from the bottom of L-shelves with KLSHF_ style numbers; 5 1/2" between bottom of L-shelf and top of stationary shelf; overall stationary shelf height 6 5/32"; specify same width as corresponding L-shelf. Stationary shelf cannot hang from an upmounted bin or shelf.
L-shelves can be mounted in front of slatwall skin or upmounted on Answer slatwall as long as there is not another bin or shelf or slatwall skin on the adjacent in-line panel.

L-shelves are intended as a companion to Universal curved front bins; they will not align horizontally if mounted adjacent to a Universal over the case or Universal in the case bin in standard or upmount applications.
L-shelves come standard with basic attachment bracket; upmount brackets are optional (see Bracket Application Rules, page 298).

Underline task light: 3/4" profile, mounts flush to bottom of Universal bins and shelves with screws; field-installed, pre-drilled holes provided; housing 24"W and 3/4"H; dark champagne, pewter, black; spiral 9' cord option.

L-shelf surface materials: paint or metallic paint (optional); endcaps for L-shelf and stationary shelf 6695 Midnight only; basic attachment brackets black; spacers plastic 6695 Midnight only; rods shiny chrome; basic upmount bracket painted to match shelf; open design upmount bracket shiny chrome.
Bookends (6695 Midnight only) divide space in bins and shelves; actual dimensions depth 5 1/4", width 6", height 8".
ADA pull mounts to inside of bin door and makes it possible to close the bin from a seated position; ordered separately; 6695 Midnight only.
Ganging bracket is recommended on all panels; joins adjacent overhead bins and shelves for optimal visual alignment; ordered separately; paint or metallic paint (option).
Slim shelves attach to Answer, Kick, Series 9000, Avenir and Montage with panel-specific brackets; extruded aluminum shelf.
Answer will not support two slim shelves installed end to end.
Slim shelves can be mounted off-module; no more than 12" overhang on either side of panel is recommended. Brackets attach on vertical seams of panel; shelf adjusts off-module on the brackets.
Two attachment brackets are included with shelves less than or equal to 48"W. Two attachment brackets and a mid-span support are included with shelves wider than 48"W.
Gap at back of slim shelf allows routing of shelf light cord. Actual dimensions: depth 6 3/8"; widths 24, 30, 36, 42, 48, 60, 72, 96".

Bracket Application Matrix (TS Series bins, Universal sliding door, over the case and in the case bins, and Universal shelves; NOT Universal curved front bins or L-shelves): On-module brackets - Answer, Kick, Series 9000, Avenir, Montage. Single side vertical off-module - Answer, Kick, Series 9000, Avenir, Montage. Two sided vertical off-module - Answer, Kick, Series 9000, Avenir, Montage. Horizontal off-module - Montage only. Upmount - Answer, Kick, Series 9000, Avenir, Montage.

On-module brackets and hooks mount overhead bins and Universal shelves to panels with vertical slot patterns; Answer, Kick, Series 9000, Avenir and Montage panels can support on-module attachment brackets. On-module attachment brackets install in panel seams.
Universal personal shelves can attach on-module to all panels except Montage.
Width of overhead storage unit must match the width of the panel or panels that it is attached to (on-module). Storage bins or shelves may span up to two panels.

Additional support for stability may be required when shelves and overhead storage bins are attached to panels; counterbalancing loads on opposite sides of panels increases stability (see Stability Guidelines in each corresponding specification guide).

On-module brackets can be used above and adjacent to slatwall on Answer and Montage panels. On-module brackets can be used with a panel stacker on Answer, Kick and Montage panels; follow standard panel stacker guidelines for each panel.
Off-module brackets are used with bins up to 12" larger than the panel, allowing them to overhang the panel seam.

Vertical off-module brackets (optional) mount one or two sides of the overhead bin off-module on Answer, Kick, Series 9000, Avenir and Montage with vertical-slot-patterned panels; both attach to the on-module bracket that comes standard with the bin. Vertical off-module brackets allow bins to be installed a maximum of 12" off-module (one side 12" max; two sides x + y = 12" max).
Vertical off-module brackets can be used with 30"W to 60"W Montage bins only.

Vertical off-module brackets can be used above and adjacent to slatwall on Answer and Montage panels, and with a panel stacker on Answer, Kick and Montage panels (follow standard panel stacker guidelines).

Horizontal off-module brackets (optional) accommodate off-module installation of overhead storage bins on panels with horizontal slot patterns; enhanced off-module Montage frames support them and must be specified for horizontal off-module Montage configurations. Horizontal off-module brackets can be used with 24"W to 48"W Montage bins only.

Horizontal off-module brackets can be used above and adjacent to slatwall on Montage panels and with a panel stacker on Montage panels. They push the bin out from panel 5/8" on enhanced off-module Montage panels.

Horizontal off-module brackets cannot span a vertical or joint where two frames come together on enhanced off-module Montage panels; shift the bin to avoid the joint. Only two pairs of off-module brackets and associated storage can be mounted per frame.

Omit brackets option must be specified when bin is used in hutch kit or Series 9000 service module application, or when attaching bin to a horizontal wall attachment bracket. Order hutch kit or Series 9000 service module package separately. Hutch kit supports bin at 66" height; service module package supports bin at 65" height on Series 9000.

Upmount brackets (optional) can be used with Universal sliding door, Universal over the case and Universal in the case bins; they attach bins near the top of 54"H panels. TS Series bins and Universal shelves cannot be attached to upmount brackets.
Upmount bin width must match the width of the panel or panels it attaches to. Upmounted bins and shelves cannot be supported off-module.
Upmount brackets can be used with a panel stacker on Answer, Kick and Montage panels; follow standard panel stacker guidelines.

Bracket Application Matrix for Universal curved front bin and Universal L-shelf: Basic bracket - Answer, Avenir, Kick, Montage, Enhanced Off-Module Montage, Series 9000. Full off-module - Enhanced Off-Module Montage only. Upmount - Answer and Kick only.

Basic brackets mount bins and shelves to panels with vertical slot patterns and push bins and shelves 1/4" from frame. Basic attachment brackets install in panel seams and allow bins and shelves wider than the panel; total width of bin or shelf can extend 12" beyond the bracket on one side.
Width of overhead bin or shelf (curved front bin / L-shelf) must match or be wider than the width of the panel or panels it is attached to (a bin narrower than the panel is incorrect).

Basic and open design upmount brackets (optional) attach bins and shelves near the top of 54"H panels; upmounted bin and shelf height is 66"H when installed on 54"H panels. Stationary shelf cannot hang from an upmounted bin or shelf.
Upmount bin or shelf width must match the width of the panel or panels it attaches to. Upmounted bins and shelves cannot be supported off-module.

Upmounted bin or shelf can be attached in front of, above or adjacent to a slatwall as long as there is not another bin, shelf or another slatwall skin on the adjacent in-line panel. With daisy-chained lights use the open design upmount bracket.

Curved front bin and L-shelf style numbers take a bracket suffix: ANS = Answer (basic attachment bracket); NON = no basic bracket. To upmount on an Answer panel specify suffix NON and choose the upmount bracket option (basic upmount +$38 or open design upmount +$118).

Guidelines apply to Universal sliding door bin, Universal in the case bin, or Universal curved front bin on Answer and Kick panels; these restrictions must be complied with, otherwise standard Answer and Kick application guidelines apply. Failure to comply may result in personal injury.
If bins or shelves are applied at an elevation higher than 66", a perpendicular panel of same height (or up to 24" lesser height) is required.
The maximum panel run length when using a universal overhead bin or universal curved front bin on Answer or Kick panels is 12'.

Top of universal sliding door bin is not designed to support the weight of a seated person; the bin may be mounted at 38"H or lower only if another panel mounted component prevents it from being seated upon.
When ganging binder bins, the use of a tie plate is required.
Answer panel (drawing): 12' run; side support brackets required; 30" min return.

Kick panel (drawing): 10' maximum run with overhead storage bin connector clip, cantilevers and side support bracket; optional worksurface supports: 20"W H-leg, pedestal with pedestal filler, lateral file, end panel.

Kick panel (drawing): 12' maximum run - no center overhead storage bin allowed; cantilevers; side support bracket; worksurface tie plates; return panel 30"H or 42"H with 24" minimum length that must equal worksurface depth; optional worksurface supports: 20"W H-leg, pedestal with pedestal filler, lateral file, end panel.
One-high and two drawer lateral files: actual depth 18" and 23 1/8" (flush steel or open front), 18 7/8" and 24" (proud steel or wood front); widths 30, 36, 42"; heights 16", 22", 28".
Top is standard 1"H steel on units with steel fronts and standard 1 3/16"H wood veneer on units with wood fronts; other top options available.

Three base options: Universal 3" base, FrameOne foot, c:scape glide; all three bases have the same overall height. Leveling glides adjust up to 3/4" for Universal 3" base and up to 1" for c:scape glide and FrameOne foot base.

Lock is standard on lateral files, located at top left corner of drawer; standard factory-installed keyed random. Drawers are standard 12"H and open full depth. Label holder included with each drawer.
Power infeed sits proud of the panel approximately 3" and will interfere with Universal storage with the Universal 3" base, FrameOne foot base, or c:scape glide.

Flush-front pull is full width and integral with the drawer; available on steel drawers only. Proud-front pulls contemporary, handle, jazz, bar (192 mm) on steel or wood veneer drawers; c:scape pulls (200 mm) on steel only.

Drawer interiors include one hanging folder bar per drawer in each 18"D case and two rails per drawer in each 24"D case. Rail packages accommodate two rows of letter-size files in 30"W and 36"W drawers and three rows in 42"W drawers. Divider packages include three dividers per drawer; 12"H file drawers also include one hanging folder bar per drawer.
Individual drawer locks are an option; only available with field-installed locks. Safety interlock system allows only one drawer to be opened at a time.

Laminate and wood veneer tops with square-edge profiles are available in place of standard 1"H steel tops; they are 3/16" taller than steel tops. FrameOne top: 3/4"H wood or laminate top floats above a painted steel security top on six black plastic spacers; can be specified on 28"H files only, making overall height 28 1/2"H.

No-top lateral files are available for use with cushion top or beneath a common top shared among several lateral files; hardware included to attach case to worksurface; no-top option reduces height of file by 1".

Security top is an option where the file is installed beneath a worksurface but not physically attached; it is not structural and can be specified on 28"H files only; reduces overall height to approximately 27"H.
Counterweight packages must be specified for lateral files that are not ganged to another case or bolted to the floor or wall; counterweights can also be ordered separately (page 676).
Intermediate support is used with Universal one-high or 1.5-high storage as a worksurface support allowing nesting of low storage.
Tether bracket is used with one-high and 1.5-high storage to add stability and eliminate the need for a counterweight when used with the c:scape beam.
Cushion top is ordered separately for use on one-high lateral files without top.
Storage to panel bracket connects one-high, 1.5-high, 2-high, 3-high laterals and cabinets to panel for added stability and eliminates the need for return panels.

Anchor bracket secures file, cabinet or tower to floor in seismic zones; four bracket packages are required for each cabinet; anchor bracket cannot be used with pedestals. Local seismic requirements vary; for California OSHPD approved anchor bracket contact Specials.
Field-installed tops: wood veneer with square edge profile or laminate with square edge profile; can be used on an individual lateral file or larger tops can connect files to make a credenza.
Wood veneer full-fill finish option is available on field-installed wood veneer tops only. Specify file with no top option (when using field-installed top).

Cushion top is manufactured in a four seam pattern in all standard solid color seating upholstery, leather, vinyls, COM leathers and COM vinyls (Brisa, Buzz2, Chainmail, Cogent: Connect, Cricket, Elmosoft Leather, Gaja - C2C, Hampstead, Leather, Stand In, Vinyl); in a two seam pattern for all approved standard patterned seating upholstery and textured upholsteries.
Counterweight packages ship separately from case and must be field-installed.
Towers actual dimensions: depth 18, 23 1/8, 29 1/8" (flush steel front) / 18 7/8, 24, 30" (proud steel or wood front); width 24"; heights 47 1/2, 52, 65 1/2".

Door is steel or wood veneer; European-style hinges open 110 degrees; door available hinged on left or right. Locker space is 9" wide with a coat rod. Locks standard on door and drawers, factory-installed keyed random; door and drawer locks keyed alike.

Three base options (Universal 3", FrameOne foot, c:scape glide) with same overall height; all other Universal towers are available with the Universal 3" base only. FrameOne foot base and c:scape glide base are only available on 18"D and 24"D open side towers.
Leveling glides adjust up to 3/4" for Universal 3" base and up to 1" for c:scape glide and FrameOne foot base.
Lift-up door is standard on 65 1/2"H vertical drawer towers and workstation verticals and includes a fixed shelf.

Adjustable shelves on 52"H and 65 1/2"H open side towers are recessed from the front and side; adjust in 2 1/2" increments. Opening on 47 1/2"H tower is 13 1/2"H and does not come with an adjustable shelf.
Frosted glass adjustable shelves are an option on open side towers; if glass shelves are selected they replace all steel shelves in the unit.
Adjustable shelves in dual door and full front towers can be positioned in 3/4" vertical increments using a reversible bracket; the first shelf above a file drawer is a fixed shelf.

Drawer lock in open side tower is located in the top file drawer. Drawer lock in dual door, full front, vertical drawer and workstation vertical towers is approximately 36" from the floor and also secures the lift-up door on 65 1/2"H units.

Individual drawer locks are an option on workstation verticals; only available with field-installed locks. In 65 1/2"H towers the lift-up door is controlled by the lock in the drawer directly below. Exception: individual drawer locks are not available on towers with 6"H drawers.

Top will default to steel on towers with proud wood fronts since the door overlaps and partially conceals the top; wood top is available as an option. Laminate and wood veneer tops are 3/16" taller than steel tops.
Counterweight packages must be specified for certain towers that are not ganged to another tower or bolted to floor or wall; counterweights can be ordered separately (page 676).
Door on full front towers is full height and can be hinged on the left or right; coat storage space is always located on the same side as the door hinge.

Worksurface to tower connector eliminates the need for other worksurface supports next to the tower. Proud front towers align with 23 1/2"D, 24"D, 29 1/2"D and 30"D worksurfaces. Flush front towers extend 7/8" beyond 24"D and 30"D worksurfaces and 1/8" beyond 23 1/2"D and 29 1/2"D worksurfaces.
High storage to panel connector provides added stability to panels and eliminates the need for return panels.
Anchor bracket secures tower to floor in seismic zones; four bracket packages required for each cabinet; cannot be used with pedestals.

Universal lateral files actual dimensions: depth 18" and 23 1/8" (flush steel), 18 7/8" and 24" (proud steel or wood); widths 36" and 42" (30"W also listed in specifying tables); heights 40, 52, 65 1/2". Base is 3"H and integral to the case.

Lock is standard on lateral files and secures all drawers and lift-up door. On 52"H and 65 1/2"H files lock is at top left corner of drawer third from the bottom; on 28"H and 40"H files lock at top left corner of top drawer. Standard factory-installed keyed random.
Optional drawer interiors will apply to all the drawers within a single lateral file.

Lift-up door with fixed shelf is standard in the top position of 65 1/2"H cases; door is 13 1/2"H to accommodate standard-height binders. Lift-up door on flush-front cases is available with an optional roll-out shelf in place of the standard fixed shelf (roll-out shelf includes three dividers and one hanging file folder bar).
Individual drawer locks: in 65 1/2"H cases the lock in the drawer below controls the lift-up door in the top position; only available with field-installed locks.
Counterweight packages must be specified as an option for lateral files that are not ganged to another case, attached to a worksurface or bolted to the floor or wall.
No-top lateral files are available where cases will be installed under a worksurface or beneath a common top; no-top option reduces height of file by 1".
Low and medium storage-to-panel connectors are used with one-high, 1.5-high, 2-high, 3-high laterals and cabinets to provide added stability to panels and eliminate the need for return panels.

Worksurface-to-tower connector connects worksurface to tower eliminating need for other worksurface supports. When used with TS Series Tower Too in Answer applications, worksurface must be placed at 28 1/2" height. When using the worksurface-to-tower connector, the depth of the worksurface must match the depth of the tower. Actual depth 20", 26".
Low storage-to-panel connector connects one-high laterals and cabinets to panel. Overhead storage or panels over 48"H cannot be used in conjunction with low storage-to-panel connector.
Medium storage-to-panel connector connects 1.5-high, 2-high, 3-high laterals and cabinets; tall storage-to-panel connector connects 48"H, 4-high and 5-high towers to panels.
Storage-to-panel connector can be positioned on the back or side of the cabinet, only on the ends of the back or side; cannot be positioned anywhere else on the case side or back.

Storage-to-panel connectors can only be used with Universal lateral files and towers, 900 Series lateral files, or TS 200 Series lateral files manufactured on or after November 2005, and TS Series Tower Too manufactured on or after January 2009 (spec page 665 tip: Universal Storage products manufactured on or after October 2005). Black paint only. Heights 8 3/4", 16", 39 5/8".
27"H fixed pedestals align with Universal Storage with 3" base and support worksurfaces at 28 1/2"H.

25 1/2"H fixed pedestals are for use as fixed pedestals under worksurfaces installed lower than standard heights (e.g. 27"H) or as freestanding pedestals with a conversion kit under height-adjustable worksurfaces.
Only 22 5/8"D, 23 1/2"D, 28 5/8"D and 29 1/2"D pedestals can accommodate legal-size filing.
Pedestal style numbers require a front style suffix: F flush steel, P proud steel, W proud wood (e.g. RPF1827A__ becomes RPF1827AP).

c:scape pull is available on proud steel fronts only; contemporary, handle, jazz, bar pulls on proud steel or proud wood fronts; flush steel fronts have integral pull with optional full-width wood veneer pull (+$246).
Basic drawer interiors (no rails, pencil trays or box drawer dividers, -$49) available for 18"D, 24"D, and 30"D box/box/file fixed pedestals; on mobile pedestals for box/file and box/box/file.
Individual locking drawers available on file/file pedestals only (fixed +$114; mobile +$122).
Counterweights (RPCW) fit 27"H fixed pedestals only.
Pedestal fillers RPXFTAKFP (flush steel fronts, 1 3/8") and RPXFTAKPP (proud fronts, 1/2") are for 27"H fixed pedestals, on-module, Answer and Kick panels.
Flush and proud front pedestals require different conversion kits; order the correct style number for the application.
When converting a file/file pedestal with individual drawer locks, an interlocking bar is required to provide stability; order 1043922SR through Service Parts.

Mobile pedestal 1/8"H steel top is non-structural. Optional tops increase the overall pedestal height. If wood veneer top option is selected, finishes must be selected for both the wood veneer top and wood veneer fronts.

Factory-installed cushion top option (+$334 without handle, +$425 with black handle) is for RPM2421C__ only. Field cushion tops RPXTC24F/RPXTCH24F for RPM2421CF only; RPXTC24P/RPXTCH24P for RPM2421CP and RPM2421CW only.
Overhead storage bins and shelves with a "TAK" suffix can be used with Privacy Wall as well (see Architectural Solutions Specification Guide for attachment information).
Upmount brackets (upmount kit +$171) include steel back to enclose storage bin.
When ordering the omit insert option, custom material cannot be factory installed; it must be ordered from a material vendor.

A door assist mechanism (+$171 per door) cannot be used with an acrylic door insert; it can be used with standard door, markerboard insert, glass insert or omit insert. Glass insert: assist mechanism recommended.
Picture frame door inserts are available on flat front steel bins only (N.A. on radius front and wood flat front bins). Markerboard insert last order entry April 19, 2015 (G4/15).
No lock option on over the case / in the case bins is -$59 per door.

For two-sided off-module application, order two vertical off-module brackets. Vertical off-module brackets are used with panels which have vertical slot patterns including Answer, Kick, Series 9000, Avenir and Montage. For Montage, vertical off-module brackets can be used with 30"W to 60"W bins only.
72"W tackboards accommodate fabric in the horizontal direction only; vertical fabric application available on 24"W to 60"W tackboards.

Brackets to attach Avenir bins and shelves to Answer panels only work on Avenir bins and shelves manufactured since May 1997; earlier bins/shelves require brackets through Specials. Avenir binder bins cannot hang on a stacked segment of an Answer panel.
Basic attachment bracket allows only 12" off-module configurations on panels with vertical attachment; bin (or L-shelf) must be the same width or up to 12" wider than the panel.

Universal curved front bins can be upmounted on Answer slatwall skins as long as there is not another slatwall skin on the adjacent in-line panel. Open design upmount bracket cannot be used when double-pane window is in top position of panel.
On curved front bins with wood doors, only the door is wood; cabinet is painted metal and end panels are ABS.
Universal L-shelf does not align with Universal overhead bin when mounted side by side.

Stationary shelf hangs from the bottom of curved front bins (KBIN_) and L-shelves (KLSHF_); specify the same width as corresponding bin or L-shelf; cannot hang from an upmounted bin or shelf. Shelf is steel with molded endcaps.
Slim shelves with a "TAK" suffix can attach to Privacy Wall.

Security top reduces overall height by approximately 1" and is for 28"H lateral files only. FrameOne tops are available on 28"H lateral files only and add 1/2" to overall height. Laminate and wood veneer tops are 3/16" taller and add 3/16" to case height.
Service part Y30291SR (paintable black plug) can be ordered to cover the glide adjustment holes in the front of the lateral file.
Full-fill finish (option) is available on field-installed tops only. 6"H box drawers come standard with a divider package.

Some cabinets with the c:scape glide base or FrameOne foot base require a different counterweight than the Universal 3" base; counterweight packages are recommended based on case size and interior options.

Counterweight option should be specified if the cabinet is not ganged back-to-back to adjacent cabinets or bolted to the floor or wall. Cabinets ganged side-to-side require a counterweight. Counterweight packages ship separately and must be installed on site.
Height dimension listed is for units with 1" top; overall height varies if another top is selected. A tether bracket (UFSTB) is available to attach Universal units to the c:scape beam.

Open and open-open configuration suffix defines the unit as flush steel (F) or proud steel (P) to match additional Universal storage (no W). For open-open units, the shelf is affixed with screws that can be removed to adjust clips/shelf to a different height.
Cushion top seam pattern is determined by upholstery selected. Cushion top suffix: F flush steel front, P proud steel/wood front of the lateral (e.g. RPDC1830__ becomes RPDC1830F).
Glass shelves are not available on 18"D towers (open side towers: +$112 on 52"H, +$224 on 65 1/2"H).
Full front towers: the adjustable shelf is always in the top/upper position.
Full front tower counterweight (Tower package +$84) applies to 52"H tower with proud wood fronts; should be specified if cabinet is not ganged to adjacent cabinets or bolted to floor or wall.
Vertical drawer towers 52"H: tower package 1 counterweight at no cost, or no counterweight; 65 1/2"H not required.
Workstation verticals individual locking drawer option (+$366) is not available on verticals with 6"H drawers.
Lift-up door with roll-out shelf is for 65 1/2"H flush steel front files only (+$39 on 18"D, +$55 on 24"D).
Counterweight option should be specified if cabinet is not ganged back-to-back with another cabinet or bolted to the floor or wall; cabinets bolted side-to-side now require a counterweight.
65 1/2"H files with individual lock option do not have a lock in the lift-up door; lift-up door is locked by the drawer below.
Worksurface-to-tower connectors are 24" and 30" nominal depth (UFSTOWER24, UFSTOWER30).

Storage-to-panel connectors can only be used with Universal Storage products manufactured on or after October 2005. Low = one-high storage (8 3/4"H); medium = 1.5-high, 2-high, 3-high storage (16"H); tall = 48"H, 4-high and 5-high towers (39 5/8"H); left- and right-hand versions.

Steel security tops are for field installation only; should only be used on units positioned under a worksurface (NOT structural); cannot be installed on a file with a lift-up door in the top position.
Adjustable shelves for towers are for field installation only. Adjustable glass shelves are for open side towers only.

Pedestal rails/dividers RXADRL15, RDV1506, RDV1512, RDV151210 are for pedestals manufactured after February 22, 2004 and Universal towers and workstation verticals; for pedestals on or before February 22, 2004 see Service Parts. Two rails per drawer accommodate side-to-side filing of letter-, A4- and legal-size folders; exception: legal-size cannot be filed in 18"D pedestals.

Pedestals with box drawers include one pencil tray per pedestal. Hanging folder bars RAHF are for Universal lateral files and combination cabinets manufactured on or after October 17, 2005, and 900 Series, 800 Series and TS 200 Series lateral files manufactured on or after May 5, 1997.

All lateral file drawer sizes require two rails per drawer for maximum capacity front-to-back filing. Actual rail dimensions are 15 1/2" deep for an 18" deep cabinet and 20" deep for a 24" deep cabinet.
Four anchor bracket packages (RAANBRK) are required for each cabinet.
Underworksurface lateral file fillers: order filler which matches nominal worksurface depth; 24"D filler is used with 18"D storage; 30"D filler is used with 18"D or 24"D storage.

All locking products are standard with factory-installed, keyed-random locks. Consecutive, specific and random keying are available as field-installed options. Exception: individual locking drawers are only available with field-installed locks.

Two lock types: standard keying system (FR series, keys FR305 to FR454) and master keying system (XF series, XF1001 to XF1150; all XF locks open with a single master key). Factory-installed locks are always key random (standard) or master key random (+$23 option). All locks within a unit are keyed alike.
Random keying can mean that different furniture units have the same key number; if all locks must be keyed differently, specify field-installed key specific or key consecutive lock cylinders.

Field-installed locks are only available on products that include factory-installed lock mechanisms. Specify "plug" when specifying furniture and the product ships with a plastic plug in place of the lock cylinder. Front-removable lock cylinders must be specified separately; a special lock tool must be ordered to install or remove cylinders in the field (lock tools are reusable). Lock cylinders ship separately.

Field keying choices: random (standard), specific (any key number FR305-FR454 / XF1001-XF1150; designate quantity per key number), consecutive (select beginning key number; no two locks share a key until sequence repeats). All available with master keying.

Lock price is included in price of furniture with locks. Field-installed lock cylinder includes two keys. For replacement lock cylinders refer to Service Parts. Lock cylinders can be changed in the field using the appropriate lock tool (877102003SR standard, 877102002SR master).
